reviews.rationale: The deployed fixture is 150 B above target with 3,946 B of hard-limit margin; its typed and provenance-bound transactions, monotonic deadlines, Search ROM framing, and release-confirmed rollback are required deterministic evidence.

The attribution build deliberately disables LTO and jump tables for exact stack and map evidence; it retains 2,220 B of hard-limit margin, and removing transaction, correlation, deadline, or rollback paths would weaken the approved deterministic contract.

The padding-free object owns the complete configuration and snapshot, exact receipt correlation, monotonic and deadline anchors, and lifecycle, phase, and search state; its 2 B hard margin imposes zero growth and requires fresh review after any ABI change.

The deployed LTO build retains the corrected four-probe replay, complete transaction attribution, qualification decisions, and learner-visible reporting while remaining 2,722 bytes below the hard limit.

The exact attribution build deliberately disables LTO and jump tables so stack, map, call-edge, chronology, and provenance evidence remain inspectable. Its 188-byte hard margin imposes zero growth and requires fresh review after any implementation or toolchain change.

The canonical recurring fixture contains exactly one 764-byte policy and one 477-byte builder; phase-local values are absent from globals, and the deployed image remains 98 bytes below the hard limit.
The exact linked image corroborates ordinary static placement byte-for-byte, proves single policy and builder instances, excludes phase-local globals, and retains 98 bytes of hard-limit margin.
The conservative no-LTO call graph includes retained large-return and replay paths and remains 107 bytes below the hard limit; its 255-byte replay frame safely covers the 180-byte phase-local peak.

The policy retains the exact prior normalized cycle required for collision-free changed-duplicate rejection and complete four-probe qualification provenance. Its four-byte hard margin imposes zero growth and requires fresh review after any ABI change.

The single caller-owned builder retains the bounded four-probe staged evidence needed for atomic finalization, chronology, and complete transaction correlation while remaining 35 bytes below its hard limit.

Recurring storage is exactly one 764-byte policy plus one 477-byte active builder; overlaying either would prevent retained-cycle comparison or staging the next acquisition. The placement remains 39 bytes below its hard limit.
The peak combines the required 1,241-byte recurring placement with one lifetime-reused 180-byte phase value; map evidence excludes duplicate phase globals and leaves 371 bytes of hard-limit margin.
